programme_name: Máster Universitario en Gestión Forestal basada en Ciencia de Datos (DATAFOREST)
official_status: máster universitario (official) — RUCT 4316066, estado 'Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA)', Nivel MECES 3, verificado 15/12/2016, BOE 05/02/2018 y 09/03/2018, renovación de acreditación favorable 28/09/2021
ects: 90 (UVa page: '90 ECTS', '3 Cuatrimestres'; RUCT breakdown: 39 obligatorios + 33 optativos + 6 prácticas + 12 TFM)
modality: Presencial (UVa official programme page). Campus Palencia, E.T.S. de Ingenierías Agrarias. Part-time route of 30 ECTS/year is advertised by the IUFOR/programme site.
language_of_instruction: 'Español, Inglés' — verbatim from the UVa official programme page (idiomas field). Not a single-language programme; the UVa international-relations page additionally advertises a 30-ECTS semester 'taught completely in English'.
tuition_total_eur: 2,358.00 EUR full programme = 26.20 EUR/credit (Másteres que NO habiliten para el ejercicio de actividades profesionales reguladas, primera matrícula, Anexo II Decreto 8/2024) x 90 ECTS. Administrative fees (secretaría, seguro) additional and not included.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27 — UVa matrícula page states verbatim 'Se prorrogan para el curso 2026-27 los precios establecidos en el curso 2024-25', i.e. the Anexo II rates of Decreto 8/2024 (BOCyL núm. 106, 3 June 2024)
non_eu_surcharge: NO differentiated non-EU / non-resident price. Decreto 8/2024 (Castilla y León) contains no article setting a distinct price for 'extranjeros no residentes'; Anexo II distinguishes only habilitante vs no habilitante and matrícula number. UVa's own máster matrícula page likewise carries no nationality-based rate. Non-EU applicants do pay the separate one-off fee 'Evaluación del expediente del título extranjero para acceder a enseñanzas de máster y doctorado' (Anexo I) — that is an admission-file fee, not a tuition surcharge.
complementary_credits_required: FOR THE TITLE: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT (the 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' row is absent for 4316066). FOR THE APPLICANT: the UVa programme page's admission section requires only 'un Título Universitario oficial' (or EHEA equivalent) plus English at 'nivel B1 del Marco Común Europeo', and lists a points-based merit scale (affinity of degree up to 3, marks up to 3, languages up to 2, exchanges up to 1, professional experience up to 1) — no complementos de formación are stated. Note Decreto 8/2024 art. 3.2 confirms that where a UVa master does impose complementos they are charged at the same per-credit rate.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 NOT PUBLISHED. Published 2026-27 UVa master preinscripción calendar (three rounds): R1 2 February – 8 April 2026 (list 16 Apr, matrícula 17–21 Apr); R2 17 April – 9 July 2026 (list 20 Jul, matrícula 21–27 Jul); R3 21 July – 31 August 2026 (list 10 Sep, matrícula 11–15 Sep). All rounds close at 13:00 local time on the closing day. Do not shift forward.
notes: 90 ECTS over 3 semesters means this does NOT finish in one academic year — relevant to a Sept-2027 start. Classified in RUCT under rama 'Ingeniería y Arquitectura', campo 'Ingeniería química, de los materiales y del medio natural' — it is a forestry title with a data-science method core, not a general data-science master. UVa also runs a joint double-master programme with the Máster en Ingeniería de Montes (separate page). Contact: master.gestion.forestal@uva.es.

programme_name: Máster Universitario en Derecho Digital y de la Inteligencia Artificial (MUDDIA) / Mestrado Universitario en Dereito Dixital e da Intelixencia Artificial
official_status: máster universitario (official) — RUCT 4317212, estado 'Publicado en B.O.E.', Nivel MECES 3, verificado 18/05/2020, BOE 17/09/2020 y 20/05/2021. Rama: Ciencias Sociales y Jurídicas.
ects: 60 (estudos.udc.es: '60 créditos'; RUCT breakdown: 45 obligatorios + 3 optativos + 6 prácticas externas + 6 TFM). Two semesters, Facultade de Dereito.
modality: 'Presencial con complemento de herramientas de teleaprendizaje (Moodle, Teams)' — UDC Facultade de Dereito programme page.
language_of_instruction: NOT FOUND verbatim. No 'lingua de impartición' / 'idioma de impartición' field is published on estudos.udc.es (study/start or study/detail) or on the Facultade de Dereito page; the per-subject language appears only inside each guía docente, which was not opened. Evidence available: the whole curriculum and all subject titles are published in Spanish/Galician only, and the faculty page is authored in Spanish — treat as Spanish/Galician pending a guía docente check, but do NOT record English on the strength of the site's English version (the English page title 'Master's Degree in Digital Law and Artificial Intelligence' is a site translation, not a language statement).
tuition_total_eur: NOT FOUND as a single confirmed figure — the epígrafe (A or B) of this title is not published on any UDC page found. Rate structure IS confirmed: (a) ordinary Galician public price, Decreto 72/2026 for 2026/27, máster non-habilitante primera matrícula = 13.93 EUR/credit (epígrafe A) or 9.85 EUR/credit (epígrafe B) → 835.80 or 591.00 EUR for 60 ECTS; (b) THIS CANDIDATE does not qualify for those (see non_eu_surcharge) and pays the UDC non-resident rate = 17.41 EUR/credit (epígrafe A) or 12.31 EUR/credit (epígrafe B) → 1,044.60 or 738.60 EUR for 60 ECTS, plus tarifa terceira secretaría fees. A law master is most plausibly epígrafe B, but that is NOT confirmed and is not recorded as fact.
tuition_year_of_rates: Ordinary prices: 2026-27 (Decreto 72/2026, do 29 de xuño, DOG 127 de 09/07/2026, plus corrección de erros DOG 130 de 14/07/2026). Non-resident per-credit figures quoted above are the 2025/26 ones (Resolución do reitor do 30/06/2025); Decreto 72/2026 art. 2.5 caps the 2026/27 non-resident price at the 2025/26 level, and a UDC Resolución reitoral do 2 de xullo de 2026 setting the 2026/27 figures exists but its text was not opened.
non_eu_surcharge: YES — real, quantified, and it applies to this candidate. Decreto 72/2026 art. 2.5 lets Galician universities set separate prices for 'alumnado extranjero mayor de dieciocho años que no tenga la condición de residente'. UDC exercises it: 'Resolución do reitor, do 30 de xuño de 2025, pola que se establecen os prezos de matrícula no curso 2025/26 para o alumnado estranxeiro maior de 18 anos que non teña a condición de residente permanente ou de longa duración' sets the price at 25% of the reference cost (5,170 EUR epígrafe A / 3,650 EUR epígrafe B, art. 2.2), giving máster non-habilitante primera matrícula 17,41 EUR/crédito (A) or 12,31 EUR/crédito (B) — roughly +25% over the ordinary decree rate. Exemptions (art. 1.2) are EU nationals, EEA/Switzerland, and nationals of medium/low-HDI countries listed in the Anexo. TUNISIA IS NOT IN THAT ANEXO (checked the full list), so a Tunisian applicant pays the surcharged rate. Note the article requires residencia PERMANENTE o de LARGA DURACIÓN — a student stay authorisation does not exempt.
complementary_credits_required: FOR THE TITLE: 0 (RUCT) — the RUCT detail page for 4317212 publishes 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos: 0'. FOR THE APPLICANT: NOT FOUND — no complementos de formación rule for non-law backgrounds was located on the UDC admission pages consulted; the 25-place programme is run by the Facultade de Dereito with Facultade de Informática teaching staff, and a software-engineering applicant should assume the admission committee may impose them until the acceso e admisión page is read in full.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 NOT PUBLISHED. 2026-27 UDC master calendar (governed by the Normativa de preinscrición e matrícula en mestrados 2026/27, approved by Consello de Goberno 16/12/2025, published in the TEO on 09/01/2026): three periods — anticipado (early 2026; admitted applicants capped at 50% of places), ordinario preinscripción 11 June – 13 July 2026 with first matrícula 31 July – 4 August 2026, and extraordinario. All deadlines close at 23:59 peninsular Spanish time on the closing day. Do not shift forward.
notes: UDC's own site is a redirect maze: www.udc.es 301s to www.udc.gal. The code '4539V01' shown on estudos.udc.es is UDC's internal plan code, NOT the RUCT code — the RUCT code 4317212 was confirmed from the register itself (RUCT title reads 'por la Universidad de A Coruña'), and does not appear on any UDC page consulted. The UDC master admission calendar is published only as PNG images (E_Plazo-anticipado_2026.PNG etc.) on udc.gal, so the ordinary-period dates above come from the search index summarising UDC pages rather than from a page that could be read directly — SOURCE_ACCESS: search index; needs a human to open https://www.udc.gal/gl/futuros_estudantes/masteres/prazos-e-datas-de-admision/ in a normal browser. Fit caveat for this candidate: this is a LAW master (rama Ciencias Sociales y Jurídicas, campo 'Derecho y especialidades jurídicas'), not an AI/engineering one.

institution: Universidade da Coruña (UDC, coordinating) + Universidade de Santiago de Compostela (USC), with CESGA
programme_name: Máster Universitario en Computación de Altas Prestaciones / High Performance Computing
official_status: máster universitario (official) — RUCT 4316445, estado 'Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA POR ACREDITACIÓN INSTITUCIONAL)', Nivel MECES 3. RUCT detail: verificación 18/04/2018, Consejo de Ministros 03/08/2018, BOE acuerdo 07/09/2018, plan de estudios BOE 11/03/2019, inicio 2018/19, acreditación institucional 28/01/2019, modificación 08/05/2022, modificación no sustancial 24/02/2025. Centros: Facultad de Informática (UDC) y E.T.S. de Ingeniería (USC).
ects: 60 (RUCT: 27 obligatorios + 12 optativos + 6 prácticas externas + 15 TFM; USC page repeats the same breakdown). 1 year full-time or 2 years part-time at 30 ECTS/year.
modality: Presencial (USC: 'In-person instruction at the Escola Técnica Superior de Enxeñaría, Santiago de Compostela'; masterhpc.es lists it as full-time, with the UDC side taught at the Facultade de Informática, A Coruña). Teaching is split across two cities plus CESGA.
language_of_instruction: 'Spanish, Galician, English' — the three languages listed on the USC official programme page. The programme's own site (masterhpc.es) describes teaching as Spanish, with English B1 required (certifiable before graduation, not at admission). Treat as predominantly Spanish/Galician with English materials; NOT an English-taught master.
tuition_total_eur: Programme's own site states, for 2024-25: EU students approximately 850 EUR and non-EU students approximately 1,250 EUR for the master. Cross-check from the Galician decree for 2026-27: máster non-habilitante, primera matrícula 13.93 EUR/credit (epígrafe A) x 60 = 835.80 EUR ordinary; UDC non-resident rate 17.41 EUR/credit x 60 = 1,044.60 EUR plus secretaría fees. The ~850 EUR figure matches epígrafe A ordinary pricing, which supports (but does not prove) that this title sits in epígrafe A.
tuition_year_of_rates: 850 / 1,250 EUR figures: 2024-25 (as labelled on masterhpc.es). Decree rates cited for cross-check: 2026-27 (Decreto 72/2026, DOG 127 de 09/07/2026). UDC non-resident per-credit figures: 2025/26 (Resolución do reitor do 30/06/2025), carried forward as the cap by Decreto 72/2026 art. 2.5.
non_eu_surcharge: YES — confirmed twice over. (1) The programme's own admission page publishes two prices, EU approx. 850 EUR vs non-EU approx. 1,250 EUR (2024-25). (2) Legally: Decreto 72/2026 art. 2.5 authorises Galician universities to set separate prices for foreign students over 18 without resident status, and UDC's 'Resolución do reitor, do 30 de xuño de 2025' sets máster non-habilitante primera matrícula at 17,41 EUR/crédito (epígrafe A) / 12,31 EUR/crédito (epígrafe B), being 25% of the reference cost (5,170 / 3,650 EUR). Exempt are EU/EEA/Swiss nationals and nationals of the medium/low-HDI countries in the Anexo — TUNISIA IS NOT LISTED, so a Tunisian applicant pays the surcharge. The resolution requires residencia permanente o de larga duración to escape it; a student stay does not qualify.
complementary_credits_required: FOR THE TITLE: 0 (RUCT) — the RUCT detail page for 4316445 publishes 'Complementos Formativos: 0'. FOR THE APPLICANT: no complementos are imposed; instead the programme sets substantive entry prerequisites on its admission page — a bachelor's in engineering (computing, telecommunications) or applied sciences (mathematics, physics, biology), competence in 'alguno o varios de los siguientes lenguajes de programación: Java, C++, C o Fortran', basic Linux, and English B1 (certified before completing the degree, not required at admission). Selection is on academic record and CV by the Comisión Académica. A 300-ECTS software-engineering graduate meets the stated profile directly.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 NOT PUBLISHED. Two separate calendars because it is a joint title and you apply through one university. UDC (published 2026-27 calendar, from the UDC master admission rules for curso 2026/27): ordinary preinscripción 11 June – 13 July 2026, first matrícula 31 July – 4 August 2026, plus an anticipado and an extraordinario period; deadlines close 23:59 peninsular time. The masterhpc.es admission page lists UDC anticipado 6 Feb – 16 May, ordinario 26 Jun – 14 Jul, extraordinario 25 Aug – 7 Sep, and USC 20 Jun – 16 Jul with matrícula 5–9 Aug — but states NO academic year, and those UDC dates do NOT match the published UDC 2026/27 window, so they are an earlier year's calendar. Do not use them as 2027 dates.
notes: The predecessor title, RUCT 4312423 ('Máster Universitario en Computación de Altas Prestaciones por la Universidad de A Coruña y la Universidad de Santiago de Compostela'), is EXTINGUIDA — do not cite that code; the live title is 4316445, confirmed by running the RUCT search for 'altas prestaciones' and reading the detail page. UDC's internal plan code for it is 4473v02 (estudos.udc.es), which is not a RUCT code. Only 8 places are offered on the USC side. masterhpc.es is the programme's own consortium site, not a university domain — its figures are recorded as programme-published, with the Galician decree used as the primary cross-check. Strong fit for this candidate on background; the language mix is the real filter.
